# Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic

> Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic is a premium hair transplant and skin care clinic
> based in Jaipur and Sikar, Rajasthan, India. We offer FUE & DHI hair transplants,
> advanced skin treatments, permanent makeup, non-surgical weight loss, and a free
> AI-powered face & scalp assessment tool.

## About
- Clinics in Jaipur and Sikar, Rajasthan
- Expert dermatologists and certified hair transplant surgeons
- Contact: +91-9414077399
- Website: https://kezzaclinic.com

## Services
- [Hair Transplant & Restoration](https://kezzaclinic.com/hair-services.html): FUE, DHI, PRP, GFC, beard & eyebrow transplant
- [Skin Care & Dermatology](https://kezzaclinic.com/skin-services.html): HydraFacial, carbon peel, laser, anti-aging, acne scar removal
- [Permanent Makeup (PMU)](https://kezzaclinic.com/permanent-makeup.html): Microblading, ombre brows, lip blush, eyeliner, scalp micropigmentation
- [Non-Surgical Weight Loss](https://kezzaclinic.com/weight-loss.html): Body sculpting & personalised weight management programs
- [AI Face & Scalp Scanner](https://kezzaclinic.com/face-scanner.html): Free AI-powered preliminary assessment (MediaPipe technology)
